analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter compatibility problems when installing [product_name] [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 7 x64. Needing to install an older version before upgrading forces users with 64-bit systems to seek workarounds. Official support is available only for 32-bit operating systems for this version, prompting users to look for alternative methods.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software to support installation on current operating systems like Windows 7 64-bit and to offer an easy upgrade process.
